ambiguities_or_notes: The opening Tolstoy paragraph, five numbered readings, all attributions, and the closing Tolstoy sentence are represented.
The page 17→18 break is preserved after the opening paragraph; the page 18→19 break is preserved before item 5.
Biblical quotations are translated from the Russian wording printed by Tolstoy rather than silently substituted with a modern English Bible version.
прикраса неправды is retained closely as “an ornament of unrighteousness,” despite its unusual Englishness, because the Russian compilation itself is unusual.
С восточного remains the nonspecific attribution “From the East.”
Recovery provenance: reconstructed after the later workspace was lost, using the baseline-pinned source identity and the official 90-volume text as the readable witness.
